note: Human template: the clean 65-bone UAL2 skeleton from UAL2_Standard.glb, fitted to an A-pose mesh (head to -Y, south) by landmarks. Bone frames are rotated rigidly, so UAL2/UAL1 actions retarget by rest-relative rotation. Protected spec: change under DOC-5.

landmarks.note: Detected on the A-pose mesh from horizontal slices (fractions of height H). handFraction = hand length as a fraction of shoulder-to-fingertip. Recipe rig.landmarks overrides any of: crown, head_base, neck_base, pelvis, spine_01..03, clavicle_l/r, shoulder_l/r, elbow_l/r, wrist_l/r, hand_end_l/r, palm_l/r, hip_l/r, knee_l/r, ankle_l/r, ball_l/r, toe_l/r, face, back.

pelvisTravelNote: Horizontal pelvis travel taken from a source action is clamped to this fraction of body height, so lunges and rolls stay on the canvas while the root stays on the anchor (L2).
